name: Nihongo Master v1.1.6
changelog: v1.1.6: Resolved taskbar minimization on exiting 3D Hiragana Cards by disabling SDL focus minimization and restoring fullscreen launcher focus. Added auto-hiding mouse cursor parity (hidden by default, reveals on deliberate movement, auto-hides after 2s idle or controller input). Structured all 8 card stages into 3 progressive sets with escalating decoy difficulty.
